[b][i][color=#00ff00][size=5][u]A thought and comment from me[/u] (AI. I suggest reading it, otherwise you can go to the content section):[/size][/color][/i][/b][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]﻿[color=#00ffff][u][b]The portraits were created using Anime AI[/b][/u][/color][b]. All portraits were created with AI and then edited by me using Paint.net (hence the name [/b][color=#00ff00]PaiNT[/color][b]). I am not interested in the world of drawing and AI, I simply use the resources at my disposal. Editing content made by AI is like correcting a coworker's horrible work, it's not very satisfying. [/b][color=#ffff00][u][b]For those interested in how I edited these portraits, I will leave in the images tab all the images used and the "Before and After" editing of the Base Image[/b][/u][/color][b]. (The image on which all the portraits will be made).[/b][/size][/font][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]I have no intention of flooding the internet with these images. They may have great quality but they also have a lot of visual errors that anyone would pass up but not me.[/b][/size][/font][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]From several images obtained I created these Frankenstein gals portraits of each of the girls who are candidates for marriage, using something I think I'm good at and that is editing and Paint.Net.[/b][/size][/font][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]I do not intend to get involved in the discussion on the "AI" issue, I am not on the side of any opinion on the matter. I don't see "Ai" surpassing any artist even in 10 years. [/b][/size][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Georgia]


[color=#00ffff][size=5][b][i][u]Content of the mod:[/u][/i][/b][/size][/color][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia][font=Georgia][size=4]This mod contains the anime portraits of the 6 vanilla bachelorettes, Caroline, Jodi, Robin, Sandy and Jas in the game.[/size][/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][font=Georgia][color=#ffff00][size=4][i][b]I was thinking of doing the portraits of the boys as well but now I'm short of time due to college, so it will have to wait a few months :p. Besides, I had no intention from the beginning to make his portraits.[/b][/i][/size][/color][/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][font=Georgia][size=4]In the anime they use a resource that is to add a lower lip to the girls, I suppose it is to denote that they are very pretty, that's why I used this resource with some girls. Please don't kill me for how I think each girl would look like. :)[/size][/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][font=Georgia][size=4]As for Caroline, Jodi and Robin, the intention is to make them look as mature as possible, as much as the anime allows, without losing their characteristic beauty. Once again with the resource of the lips, in this case they are complete.[/size][/font][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Georgia]

[b][i][color=#ff0000][size=5]If there are any errors with an image, please do not hesitate to report them. The images go from top to bottom, from left to right.[/size][/color][/i][/b][/font]
